summary: Independently verified634 provider files against original W2 bytes, six selected source Git blobs and SHA256s, two decoder dependency manifests, and original JPEG Git blob. Recomputed all ten counterfactuals in a fresh Node process using an own provider copy and only prior-receipt path relocation; every receipt field matches C1 except timestamp and adapted producer SHA. Baseline27.75px and S5 64.75px rawtrace controls, canonical decode/config/field identities, before/after field hashes, all10 UNKNOWN/noBasket outcomes, and both-endpoint-outside segment lengths are confirmed. Original figure inspected and own re-render has identical PNG SHA256, with seeds distinguished from emitted points and canonical→source y+4 explicit. Accepted as bounded one-image negative mechanism evidence, not persistent route evidence, ownership, course accuracy or human acceptance.
